d.ko: Yacht Dice is a classic dice game popular around the world, each player by throwing dice statistics score to carry on the game, the player with the highest score wins. Invite friends to play online, or compete against players from around the world.
d.en: Yacht Dice is a classic dice game popular around the world, each player by throwing dice statistics score to carry on the game, the player with the highest score wins. Invite friends to play online, or compete against players from around the world.
d.zh: 快艇骰子是一款风靡世界的经典骰子游戏，每个玩家通过投掷骰子统计分数来进行游戏，得分最高的玩家获胜。可邀请好友一起在线切磋，或者与世界各地的玩家一较高下。游戏使用精美的3D游戏画面，真实模拟现实世界的碰撞体验。
